title: 第27章 离开猪人部落第28章 遇半人马
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
战斧家族，很快在猪人部落稳定下来，渐渐的被猪人部落接受。而孙云等蚁的身份问题，也终于得到了解决，就是这猪人部落的一个商业小家族。
经过孙云等人的商议，孙云提升一个比较聪明的蚁兵军官，负责各个商店的护卫。并且被命他为，猪人部落战斧家族负责人，统管猪人部落战斧家族大小事宜。
一个老狐人，为财政负责人，把战斧产业交接给他管理。并且，由蚁兵军官和老狐人共同保管财务，共同决定财务走向。
经过一断时间的适应，二人渐渐熟悉了自己的角色，倒是没出什么岔子。虽然，二人行事没有孙云和狐人华叔想的周全，但也安排的头头是道，商店也经营的有声有色。
实际上，蚁兵军官行事作风，也受到了孙云的影响，除了偶尔看查一下仓库，很少理会财务方面。而老狐人，也本分的把每次财产动向，各店铺每天的单据，向蚁兵军官汇报。
“云，你在想什么？”
疯战看着孙云的背影，关心的问道。
疯战也是唯一一个，敢直接称呼孙云名字的手下，与孙云没有多大距离感。他们两个，没事就在一起切磋，让他们渐渐形成了别样的友情。
疯战，也是除了黑头之外，最了解孙云的手下了。
“让你们做的事，怎么样了？”孙云反问道！
这猪人部落，只是孙云的一个落脚点，孙云不可能长待。最近这段时间，孙云打算继续出发，走出这个贫困的猪人部落。
“已经按照你的标准，全部挑好了！我们是不是太急了，要不要等稳定了再走？“疯战担心的问道。
战斧家族，现在正处于发展阶段，可以说是琐事太多了。没有孙云主持大局，发展速度必然受到限制，行事也会畏首畏尾！
“疯战，你和我都心里清楚，我们的志向不在于此。战斧家族，只是一个皮囊，我们要把握有限的时间，去做我们认为该做的事。人这一辈子，要知道取舍，不能太追求完美了！”
孙云破天荒的解释了一次！
孙云想走出去，寻找自己想要的生活环境，自然要趁自己有激情的年龄。猪人部落，只是孙云游历的开始，他想要寻找智慧种族，了解这个世界的文明。
“行，既然你决定了，那我只负责打前阵！”
疯战点点头，无所谓的说道。
疯战的要求很简单，就是提升战斗能力，让自己更强。对于，孙云要带他去哪，对他来说一点都不重要！
“是时候了，召集大家过来吧！”

孙云点点头吩咐道！
这次，孙云的游历小队，是以押送粮食的借口出去的。猪人部落，最盛产的就是粮食，自然要贩卖到更需要的地方。当然，孙云不但带了订单上的数量，还多追加了一半，作为突发情况的备用。
”好的！”
疯战答应一声转身离去，留下孙云独自沉思。
这次，孙云本来打算留下华叔主持大局的，可小狐女媚儿也非要跟随，华叔自然不放心。火狐华叔一再要求，要跟在媚儿公主身边，要把她保护到成年。
孙云也没有刻意反对，反而让华叔继续在身边，接着担任小队的管家。当然，挑选的狐人战士，还是要按规矩办事，由古特带领。古特挑选的不是最强的，而是人品比较好，而且能配合团队的。
“孙哥，我们来了！”
最积极的火狐媚儿，首先和华叔赶过来！
火狐媚儿之所以要跟随，是对孙云怀有很大的好奇心，她感觉孙云是一个特别的人。无论在天赋和智慧上，都不是非常拔尖的一类人，却总是能创造奇迹。
content_en:
The Tomahawk family quickly stabilized in the Pig Tribe and was gradually accepted by the Pig Tribe. The identity problem of Sun Yun and other ants has finally been solved. They are a small business family in this pig tribe.
After discussion by Sun Yun and others, Sun Yun promoted a smarter ant soldier officer to be responsible for guarding each store. And he was appointed as the head of the Tomahawk Family of the Pig Tribe, in charge of all matters of the Tomahawk Family of the Pig Tribe.
An old fox man was the person in charge of finance, and the management of the tomahawk industry was handed over to him. Moreover, the ant soldier officers and the old fox men jointly keep the finances and jointly decide the financial direction.
After a period of adaptation, the two gradually became familiar with their roles, and nothing went wrong. Although the two of them did not act as thoughtfully as Sun Yun and Fox Man Hua Shu did, they still arranged things in a sound way and the store was run smoothly.
In fact, the behavior of the Ant Soldier officers was also influenced by Sun Yun. Apart from occasionally checking the warehouse, he rarely paid attention to financial aspects. The old fox man also duly reported every property movement and daily receipts from each store to the ant soldier officers.
"Yun, what are you thinking about?"
Mad Zhan looked at Sun Yun's back and asked with concern.
Kuang Zhan was also the only subordinate who dared to call Sun Yun directly by his name, and there was no sense of distance between him and Sun Yun. The two of them sparred together whenever they had nothing to do, and they gradually formed a different kind of friendship.
Mad Zhan is also the subordinate who knows Sun Yun best besides Black Tou.
"How's it going with what I asked you to do?" Sun Yun asked back!
This pig tribe is just a foothold for Sun Yun, and Sun Yun cannot stay here long. During the recent period, Sun Yun planned to continue his journey out of this impoverished pig tribe.
"We have selected everything according to your standards! Are we in too much of a hurry? Should we wait until things are stable before leaving?" Mad Zhan asked worriedly.
The Tomahawk family is now in the development stage, and it can be said that there are too many trivial matters. Without Sun Yun in charge of the overall situation, the speed of development will inevitably be limited, and things will be timid!
"Crazy battle, you and I both know in our hearts that our ambition is not here. The Tomahawk family is just a skin. We have to seize the limited time and do what we think we should do. In this life, we must know the choices and not pursue perfection too much!"
Sun Yun explained it for the first time!
Sun Yun wanted to go out and find the living environment he wanted, so he naturally had to take advantage of his passionate age. The pig tribe is just the beginning of Sun Yun's travels. He wants to find intelligent races and understand the civilization of this world.
"Okay, since you have decided, I will only be responsible for fighting in the front line!"
Mad Zhan nodded and said indifferently.
The requirement of Mad War is very simple, which is to improve your combat ability and make yourself stronger. It doesn't matter to him where Sun Yun takes him!
"It's time, call everyone over!"
Sun Yun nodded and ordered!
This time, Sun Yun's traveling team went out under the pretext of escorting food. The pig tribe's most abundant product is food, which naturally has to be sold to places where it is needed more. Of course, Sun Yun not only brought the quantity on the order, but also added half more as a backup for emergencies.
"Okay!"
Mad Zhan agreed and turned around to leave, leaving Sun Yun alone to ponder.
This time, Sun Yun originally planned to leave Uncle Hua to take charge of the overall situation, but the little fox girl Meier also insisted on following him, so Uncle Hua was naturally worried. Firefox Uncle Hua repeatedly requested to stay with Princess Meier and protect her until she reaches adulthood.
Sun Yun did not deliberately object, but instead allowed Uncle Hua to continue to be by his side and continue to serve as the team's steward. Of course, the selected fox warriors must still follow the rules and be led by Gut. Gut didn't pick the strongest ones, but the ones with better character and who could cooperate with the team.
"Brother Sun, we are here!"
The most active Huohu Meier came over first with Uncle Hua!
HuohumeiThe reason why Er wanted to follow was that she was very curious about Sun Yun. She felt that Sun Yun was a special person. No matter in terms of talent or intelligence, he is not a very top-notch type of person, but he can always create miracles.
